title: Joint Estimation in Potts Model
summary: In this paper, we study estimation of parameters in a two-parameter Potts model with $q$ colors and coupling matrix $A_N$. We characterize concrete sufficient conditions for existence of the pseudo-likelihood estimator of the Potts model, in terms of the local magnetic fields, and give sufficient conditions for the validity of the above characterization. We then provide sufficient criteria for estimation of both parameters at the optimal rate $\sqrt{N}$.
